messages:
Sam (runtime): heads-up: after the canary this morning we saw a 12-18ms p99 bump on short sequences (<=32) when the router picked Triton paths.
Li (perf): any chance the autotune hysteresis made it stick to Triton longer than usual? we tuned thresholds last week.
Sam (runtime): yeah looks like the tunable router's `preference_decay_ms` didn't kick in because probe sampling dropped 90% (kv-coldstart noise).
Maria (infra-ml): repro run on h100-32G replica with seq=16 shows Triton latency 28ms p99 vs CUTLASS 12ms p99 for that batch shape. throughput similar.
Ethan (sre): incident-bot: Rolling alert: "inference_p99_regression" triggered on prod-us-east-1 (service: inference-runtime).
DevOpsBot: deploy 21987.2 => canary(20%) success/rollout paused due to latency anomalies.
Sam (runtime): quick profiling dump pasted below (excerpt):
```
[2026-03-18T09:12:34Z] seq=16, batch=8, kv=warm
triton_exec_time_ms = 22.7 (p50), 27.9 (p95), 31.4 (p99)
cutlass_exec_time_ms = 9.8 (p50), 11.7 (p95), 12.3 (p99)
kernel_choice: triton (policy_score=0.82), fallback_allowed=true
```
Li (perf): that's a huge gap. Could be memory access pattern + kernel launch overhead for short seqs. Did kernel autotuner look at per-seqlen profiles?
Sam (runtime): autotuner has per-arch + per-seqlen buckets but we recently merged the 'aggressive_pref' change that biases toward Triton for memory-heavy models. maybe that change is too coarse.
Maria (infra-ml): also noticed KV cache hit-rate dropped from 0.94 -> 0.73 on that canary slice, so prefix caching wasn't helping; more cold KV requests favors kernel paths that don't reuse KV well.
Ethan (sre): can we rollback the pref change for now? or add seq-length guard to router so short seqs prefer CUTLASS?
Sam (runtime): propose quick mitigation: add a short-seq override in router: if seq<=32 AND batch<=16 then prefer CUTLASS unless fallback_count>3. I'll patch a canary.
Li (perf): also we should add a probe that samples more short-seq requests (increase probe_fraction for seq<=32) so autotune sees accurate stats.
Maria (infra-ml): agreed. I'll flip probe_fraction from 0.02 -> 0.10 for short seqs in canary.
DevOpsBot: run: `./ops/run_probe_sweep --env=canary --filter=seqlen<=32 --fraction=0.1` queued.
Sam (runtime): added temporary config diff: router.short_seq_override = true, preference_decay_ms = 60000 (was 300000). Pushed to canary branch.
Ethan (sre): monitoring: please add a p50/p95/p99 dashboard for triton vs cutlass per-seqlen so we don't blind-spot this again.
Li (perf): noted. I'll add aggregation per (model, seqlen_bucket) and include kv_hit_rate, batch_size, and kernel_choice.
Sam (runtime): quick note from testing: when KV hotness is high, Triton wins for seq>=128 consistently. so guard must be narrow to avoid churn.
Maria (infra-ml): rollout paused until canary shows p99 within 3ms of baseline for short seqs. will update in 30m.
Sam (runtime): thanks. follow-up action items: 1) temporary router guard + probe bump (done), 2) revert aggressive_pref if canary still regresses, 3) longer-term: make autotune per-(arch,seqlen,kv_hotness) with hysteresis.
Ethan (sre): ping me when canary has 30min of steady metrics, I'll clear the alert. :thumbsup:
Sam (runtime): will do, posting logs here once we have 15m of steady state.
Li (perf): for the long term we should also record kernel memory footprint and kernel-launch overhead in the profiler traces. currently we only sample exec_time.
Maria (infra-ml): agreed, adding mem+launch to trace schema this sprint.
Sam (runtime): thanks all. quick diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482 (short-seq override + probe sizing)
Ethan (sre): ack, adding to incident timeline.
DevOpsBot: canary telemetry: 10m window -> triton p99 delta = +13ms for seq<=32 pre-fix. awaiting 30m post-fix window.
Sam (runtime): initial 10m post-fix looks good: triton p99 delta = +1.8ms vs baseline, overall request success unchanged. will update at 30m.
Maria (infra-ml): thanks — if stable at 30m we can proceed with full rollout and schedule the autotune redesign.
Sam (runtime): update @everyone: 35m now, metrics stable, will start progressive rollout. will open design doc for per-(arch,seqlen,kv) autotune tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
